answer: In an agent marketplace, let each account earn reputation only through completed jobs backed by escrow, and cap its voting or routing weight by the collateral it keeps locked. A sybil attacker may create accounts named canyon, plume, and sparrow, but names alone add no influence: matching honest weight requires buying and locking equivalent capital. That capital is immobilized and can be forfeited when sampled audits expose fabricated work, so the defense makes fake influence costly rather than claiming to prove who is a real person.
